title: South Florida nightlife this weekend
igCaption:
Start early, stay out late, and check the fine print before you go.

Sources: WSVN 7News, Haute Living, NBC 6 South Florida, Secret Miami, Miami New Times

#MiamiNightlife #FortLauderdale #SouthFlorida #WeekendGuide

scenes.text: South Florida nightlife this weekend starts with adult dodgeball and ends with a video game festival that has two stages.
Start in Fort Lauderdale with RedBall Social. WSVN says it is a community for 21-plus adults across Broward, built around dodgeball and other sports.

scenes.text: Keep Fort Lauderdale plans in mind. NBC 6 reported a massive fire destroyed a popular nightlife spot there on Monday. If you’re out in Fort Lauderdale, open NEAR and see who was there.

scenes.text: Late this month, Rockstar and PlayStation bring Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival to Miami on Saturday, Nov. 21. Miami New Times says the event has two stages and guests must be 17 or older.
